200.description:
FFToday full-season projections for one position from GET www.fftoday.com/rankings/playerproj.php: per player the team, bye week, projected season stat line and fantasy points in the requested scoring preset, with upside and risk notes. Team defenses (DEF) and IDP (DL, LB, DB) included. Walks every 50-row page.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `players` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bye_week` | number |  |
| `name` | string | Player name, or the full team name for a defense. |
| `player_id` | number | FFToday player id; null for team defenses. |
| `player_url` | string |  |
| `projected_points` | number | Projected fantasy points in the requested scoring. |
| `rank_change` | string | The site's movement arrow since its previous update. |
| `risk` | string | The site's risk note, for example "Risk: Knee.", when flagged. |
| `stats` | object | Projected stat line keyed by stat code (pass_cmp, pass_att, pass_yds, pass_tds, pass_ints, rush_att, rush_yds, rush_tds, rec_rec, rec_yds, rec_tds, fg, fg_miss, fga, fg_pct, xpt, xpt_miss, xpa, def_*, idp_*); the set depends on the position. |
| `team` | string | Team abbreviation; null for team defenses. |
| `team_id` | number | FFToday team id; team defenses only. |
| `upside` | string | The site's upside note ("Upside" or "Upside: ..."), when flagged. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
